[
  {
    "id": "C-001",
    "type": "ENT",
    "area": "catalog",
    "title": "Catalogue item with brand and type",
    "summary": "A catalogue item is read together with its brand and its type.",
    "claims": [
      "FindCatalogItem returns the first catalogue item with the given id, including its brand and type."
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "C-002",
    "type": "BR",
    "area": "catalog",
    "title": "New items get an id from a generator",
    "summary": "The service, not the database, assigns the id of a new item.",
    "claims": [
      "CreateCatalogItem sets the id from the hi-lo index generator before adding the item and saving."
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "C-003",
    "type": "FEAT",
    "area": "catalog",
    "title": "Paged catalogue list",
    "summary": "The catalogue is listed one page at a time, ordered by id.",
    "claims": [
      "GetCatalogItemsPaginated orders items by id, skips pageSize times pageIndex items and takes pageSize.",
      "The page also reports the total number of items."
    ]
  },
  {
    "id": "C-004",
    "type": "FEAT",
    "area": "catalog",
    "title": "Edit an item",
    "summary": "The edit page loads an item and shows its brand and type in drop-down lists.",
    "claims": [
      "On the first load the edit page reads the item id from the route and loads the item.",
      "UpdateCatalogItem marks the item as modified and saves it."
    ]
  }
]
samples.answer:
## Data model: catalogue

- CatalogItem: Id, brand reference, type reference. An item is always read together with its brand and its type (C-001), so the read model joins both.
- Id of a new item: assigned by the application from a hi-lo generator before the insert, not by the database (C-002). Keep a sequence-based generator, or move to a database identity column and record that choice as an ADR.
- Listing: paged, ordered by id, with the total count returned with each page (C-003). The new list endpoint takes pageSize and pageIndex and returns the same total.
- Updates mark the whole entity as modified and save it (C-004): the new system should decide whether to update all fields or only changed ones.
samples.note: Traceable and concrete; leaves brand and type entities out because no card describes their fields.

## Data model

- CatalogItem: Id, Name, Price, brand and type references.
- Orders table with the customer email and a payment token for every order.
- A Redis cache in front of the catalogue list, with a ten minute expiry.
- Ids are generated by the database.
